title: Coherent coefficient-extension comparison and model data
statement: For types Association, Direct and Completion, a section predicate on Association, evaluation types Evaluation(direct), a transition predicate, model types Model(direct), a model-evaluation predicate, a normalization proposition, and completion-projection and comparison predicates, define CoefficientReductionModelData to be the record of: an association with its section formula; a direct representative with its evaluated transitions; a model with its evaluation formula; a proof of normalization; a completion with its projection formula and comparison predicate. The accompanying generic comparison records and their concrete coefficient specializations are the existing interfaces relocated verbatim from CoefficientExtensionReductionModel to CoefficientExtensionReductionData. This node records the interface, not an existence assertion.

structure CoefficientReductionModelData (Association Direct Completion : Type*)
    (sectionFormula : Association → Prop) (Evaluation : Direct → Type*)
    (transitionFormula : ∀ direct, Evaluation direct → Prop) (Model : Direct → Type*)
    (modelFormula : Association → ∀ direct, Evaluation direct → Model direct → Prop)
    (Normalized : Prop)
    (completionFormula : ∀ direct, Evaluation direct → Model direct → Completion → Prop)
    (comparisonFormula : Completion → Prop)
    extends CoefficientStrictModelData Association Direct sectionFormula Evaluation
      transitionFormula
